summary: AgencyProfileClosures manages the agency-level closure records in the HSPnet system. It supports creating, editing, deleting, and viewing closures, including filtering by closure type, discipline, and site. The system facilitates workflow for managing which disciplines and destinations are affected by each closure, with support for applied destinations selection and discipline filtering. User permissions and session context are respected throughout workflows.
purpose: To provide an interface and workflow for managing agency-level closures, allowing users to add, edit, and delete closure records, control their application to disciplines and destinations, and maintain validation and business rules around closure data.

workflows.name: Add Closure
steps: User clicks Add button.
Form opens in Insert mode.
User enters closure details: ClosureCode, StartDate, EndDate, Comment.
User chooses if closure applies to all sub-disciplines or selects from discipline list.
User saves closure.
Closure is inserted via GenericClosures.Add and associated with AgencyID.

workflows.name: Edit Closure
steps: User clicks Edit button for selected closure.
Form opens in Edit mode with closure details filled.
User updates closure fields as needed.
User updates discipline selection as needed.
Closure is updated via GenericClosures.Update.

workflows.name: Delete Closure
steps: User clicks Delete button for selected closure.
Closure is deleted via GenericClosures.Delete.
Session cache is updated and user is redirected.

workflows.name: Manage Applied Destinations
steps: User selects a closure and opens Applied Destination form.
User can add/remove destinations for sites.
Selecting 'Applied All Destinations' disables individual selection.
Destinations are saved via GenericClosures.SaveAppliedDestinations.

workflows.name: Filter Closures
steps: User can filter closures by closure type, discipline, and site using dropdowns.
Filters are populated and include 'All' options.

business_rules: Closures can only be created, edited, or deleted by users with a valid session.
If 'AllowAllSubDisciplines' is selected, discipline selector is disabled.
Disciplines available for closure are determined by agency restrictions and user context.
Applied destinations can be cleared by selecting 'Applied All Destinations'.
validations: Page must be valid before insertion or update.
StartDate and EndDate are checked for format and range.
conditions: Form opens in Insert mode for Add, Edit mode for Edit.
If user has restricted sub-disciplines, discipline filter is hidden.
If 'Applied All Destinations' is checked, individual destination selection is disabled.
system_behavior: Auto-generated fields can be modified in code-behind.
Dropdowns and lists are populated dynamically based on session and agency context.
Session cache is updated after closure changes.
UpdatePanel used to refresh form content asynchronously.
dependencies: GenericClosures.* methods for CRUD and destination management.
Session context for permissions and filtering.
exceptions: If UserSession is null for a data operation, action is canceled.
If destination or site is invalid, addition/removal is aborted.
content_gaps: Exact field-level validation rules for date and closure code are not fully specified.
Business logic for restrictions on disciplines could be further detailed.
Calculation rules (if any) for closure impact are not specified.
